description: Machine-readable privacy regulation requirement matrix for Rift-CMP.

requirements.requirement: Applies to processing of personal data within GDPR territorial scope.
Processing requires an Article 6 lawful basis.
Consent must be freely given, specific, informed and unambiguous.
requirements.applicability: Where consent is selected as lawful basis

requirements.requirement: Special-category processing requires an Article 9 condition in addition to an Article 6 lawful basis.
Specific safeguards apply to information-society services offered directly to children.
exception_or_condition: Age threshold and Member State conditions

requirements.requirement: Provide required information about processing.
Support applicable data-subject rights.
Consent must be withdrawable as easily as it was given.
exception_or_condition: Withdrawal does not affect prior lawful processing

requirements.requirement: Personal data should not be kept longer than necessary for identified purposes.
Implement appropriate technical and organisational measures.
Personal-data breaches may trigger supervisory-authority and data-subject notification duties.
exception_or_condition: 72-hour supervisory notification subject to Article 33 conditions

requirements.requirement: Controller-processor relationships require Article 28 compliance.
Transfers outside the EEA require a Chapter V mechanism.
DPO requirements apply in specified circumstances.
DPIA is required for processing likely to result in high risk in specified circumstances.
Supervisory authorities may impose corrective measures and administrative fines.
Confidentiality of electronic communications must be protected.
Storing or accessing information on terminal equipment generally requires prior consent unless a statutory exception applies.
exception_or_condition: Strictly necessary to provide a service explicitly requested by the user

requirements.requirement: Direct-marketing electronic communications are subject to specific consent and exception rules.
Applies to digital personal data processed in India and specified processing connected with offering goods or services in India.
Processing requires lawful purpose and consent or specified legitimate use.
Consent must be free, specific, informed, unconditional, unambiguous and involve clear affirmative action.
Specified legitimate uses permit processing without consent.
Processing children's data requires prescribed safeguards and parental consent subject to statutory exceptions.
Provide notice concerning personal data and purpose.
Support statutory Data Principal rights.
Consent withdrawal must be as easy as giving consent.
exception_or_condition: Processing may continue where otherwise authorised

requirements.requirement: Data Fiduciary must implement reasonable security safeguards.
Personal-data breach obligations apply under the Act and Rules.
Data Fiduciary remains responsible for processing performed by processors on its behalf.
Central Government may restrict transfer of personal data outside India to notified countries or territories.
Significant Data Fiduciaries have enhanced governance obligations.
Data Protection Board may impose statutory penalties.
Rules prescribe operational requirements under the DPDP Act.
Rules prescribe requirements for notices provided by Data Fiduciaries.
Rules prescribe security safeguards and security practices.
Rules prescribe breach-notification details.
Rules prescribe safeguards relating to children's personal data.
Rules prescribe additional requirements for Significant Data Fiduciaries.
Rules have phased commencement dates.
exception_or_condition: Rules 3, 5-16 and 22-23: eighteen months after publication

requirements.requirement: Applies to businesses meeting statutory California applicability thresholds.
Business must provide required privacy notices and disclosures.
Consumer may request information concerning collection, use and disclosure subject to statutory limits.
Consumer may request deletion subject to statutory exceptions.
Consumer may request correction of inaccurate personal information.
Consumer may opt out of sale of personal information.
Consumer may opt out of sharing for cross-context behavioral advertising.
Consumer may limit certain uses and disclosures of sensitive personal information.
Special opt-in requirements apply to sale or sharing involving minors.
Business must not discriminate against consumers for exercising CCPA rights.
Qualifying opt-out preference signals must be handled as required.
Contracts must satisfy service-provider and contractor requirements.
Business must provide retention disclosures and comply with applicable minimization and retention requirements.
Business must maintain reasonable security and comply with applicable security requirements.
CPPA and Attorney General may enforce CCPA.
Additional requirements apply to specified automated decisionmaking technology.
Applies to processing within statutory Brazilian territorial scope.
Processing requires one of the LGPD statutory legal bases.
Sensitive personal data has separate legal bases and restrictions.
Consent must be free, informed, unequivocal and related to a specific purpose.
Processing of children's and adolescents' data must consider their best interests.
Provide clear and accessible processing information.
Support statutory data-subject rights.
Consent may be revoked through a facilitated procedure.
exception_or_condition: Prior lawful processing is not automatically invalidated

requirements.requirement: Processing must end in statutory circumstances and deletion rules apply.
Controllers and processors must adopt technical and administrative security measures.
Security incidents may require notification to ANPD and affected data subjects.
Controller and processor responsibilities must be distinguished.
International transfers require a statutory transfer mechanism.
Controller may need an Encarregado and governance measures.
ANPD may impose administrative sanctions.
LGPD does not create a CCPA-style universal sale/sharing opt-out.
exception_or_condition: Do not map directly to CCPA sale/sharing

requirements.requirement: State privacy applicability must be evaluated using state-specific thresholds and scope rules.
Consent requirements must be represented per state and processing activity.
Sensitive-data requirements must be represented by state.
Age thresholds and minor protections must be configurable by state.
Consumer rights must be represented individually by state.
Sale, targeted advertising, profiling and universal opt-out signals must be modeled separately.
Controller, processor, service-provider and contractor relationships must be configurable.
Entity, data, purpose and context-specific exemptions must be represented separately.
State requirements must support separate publication, effective, enforcement and amendment dates.
